messages:
Priya: Heads-up team 	6 SummitLab interview confirmed Thu 5/12 9:00am PT. Embargo lift planned for Tue 5/20. Need final quote sign-off, logo usage approval, and transcript redlines by EOD Tue 5/16. Who owns each?
Zoe: I'll own the blog draft + slide pull-quotes. Need the exact benchmark wording from the customer (p95 vs avg, units, any competitor names to avoid).
Ravi (SummitLab): Quick note from our side: please use p95 latency (not avg). Also we prefer "per-query cost" over "per-request." No competitor comparisons please. We can share anonymized % improvements vs our legacy infra.
Priya: Got it. Distribution plan: blog, 30-min customer webinar, short launch post + 3 social cuts. @Jules can you set up webinar registration and add UTM params?
Jules: Yep. Creating registration page now. Which presenters do we list? Also will add a mandatory checkbox for marketing consent.
Zoe: Proposed presenters: Alex (SummitLab Head of Search) + Priya (Redwood PM). I'll draft talking points.
Zoe: Draft quote options (from interview notes):
````
Short: "Redwood cut our p95 latency by 60% and cut per-query cost by 45%."

Long: "With Redwood we saw a 60% reduction in p95 latency and a 45% drop in per-query cost compared to our previous stack, enabling faster search and lower infra spend."
````
Mark (Legal): Please ensure any numeric claims are backed by the customer's written confirmation. Also avoid absolutes like "eliminated" and watch for mentions of third parties. Route final signed quote to legal@redwood.example for our records.
publishbot: Reminder: Marketing checklist updated  https://docs.redwood.example/marketing/case-study-checklist 
Ravi (SummitLab): We approve the short quote but prefer wording tweak: change "per-query cost" to "per-query operational cost" and remove "compared to our previous stack" 	6 we want it more concise. Also audio clips are OK but require an explicit audio release form (we'll sign).
Zoe: New short quote per customer: "Redwood cut our p95 latency by 60% and reduced per-query operational cost by 45%." Mark, any legal issues with that phrasing?
Mark (Legal): That phrasing looks fine provided SummitLab signs off in writing and we attach their signed quote PDF. Also request redaction of any customer-specific internal hostnames in the transcript.
Priya: Action list: Zoe = finalize blog using approved quote (Wed 5/11 AM), Jules = registration + UTM + webinar invite (today), Mark = confirm once signed quote uploaded, Ravi = upload signed quote & audio release to secure folder.
Jules: One scheduling flag 	6 SummitLab's Alex just asked if we can move the session to 11:00am PT. I'm proposing 11:00am PT Thu 5/12. Does that work for Redwood presenters?
Priya: 11:00am PT works for us. Jules please update invite and registration.
Ravi (SummitLab): Confirmed 11:00am PT is good. I've uploaded the signed quote and audio release here: https://drive.redwood.example/summitlab/signed-quote-2026-05-04.pdf (secure).
Mark (Legal): Received. I confirm legal sign-off on the quote and audio release. I'll add a note in the file.
Zoe: Thanks 	6 I'll swap the quote in the draft and add the slide pull-quote. For leads: how should Sales tag inbound registrants who attended the webinar?
Priya: SalesOps to tag webinar registrants with campaign=case-study_summitlab and lead_source=webinar. Jules, please include those UTM params on the registration URL.
Jules: Done. Registration page live with UTMs and consent checkbox. I'll export the attendee list to SalesOps after the webinar.
Priya: Great. Final checks: Zoe will publish draft to the internal review doc by EOD for last pass. Mark will confirm legal folder link. Ravi, appreciate quick turnaround. Closing loop here unless someone has blockers. :tada:
